risks.risk: Rust/corrosion on the lower front area may indicate water ingress, poor drainage, or long-term exposure—could affect longevity and cause future leaks.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the rust area plus a photo of the machine’s bottom edge and door seal/gasket from the side; also show the drain hose connection area.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used unit with possible moisture exposure (assume higher chance of future maintenance/leaks).

risks.risk: Seller’s “no fault” claim can’t be verified remotely; common issues include drainage problems, noisy spin, or error codes.
risks.proof: Video of a full wash cycle (including spin) with no error codes; show the display during operation.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed working perfectly (assume needs inspection/possible minor faults).

risks.risk: Exact model number/serial not readable; warranty/parts compatibility and true age can’t be confirmed.
risks.proof: Photo of the rating plate/serial label (usually on the door frame or back panel) showing model number and serial.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the worst-case for a generic 7kg LG DirectDrive used unit (no warranty confirmation).

risks.risk: Potential tampering/repairs (seller says motor never opened) can’t be confirmed from the front photo.
risks.proof: Photo of the back panel screws/cover condition and any service stickers; if possible, a quick inspection photo of the motor area (without disassembly).
risks.if_unproven: Price as if motor history is unknown (assume standard used condition, not “like new”).

proof_requests: Close-up photos of the rust/corrosion area and the door gasket/seal.
Video of a complete wash cycle (wash + rinse + spin) showing the display and no error codes.
Photo of the rating plate/serial label with the exact model number and serial.
Photos of receipt and warranty card (if available).
response.reason: The identity (LG DirectDrive 7kg) is readable, but key claims (barely used, no faults, motor never opened, warranty/receipt) and the rust risk cannot be verified from the single front photo. A wash-cycle video and rating-plate photo are needed to price confidently.
